purpose: A read-only, no-AI evaluation of selected-book retrieval. Each case constrains passage search to one named work and verifies the selected work's indexed pages against published fingerprints.

cases.question: How does Aristotle explain becoming virtuous through repeated actions?
planner_queries: Aristotle Nicomachean Ethics habituation through repeated bodily actions
forming virtuous character by performing virtuous deeds repeatedly

cases.question: According to Darwin's On the Origin of Species, how does natural selection preserve beneficial variations?

Origin of Species survival reproduction inheritance useful variations
